title: Superia
description: Superia (Sheen) is a aesthetic focused modpack which focuses on Cinematic Visuals while not making your game into a slideshow!
body:
# Superia (sheen)
Sheen is a visual-driven modpack engineered for players who want their world to look impossibly beautiful without turning their device into a furnace or a flipbook. The pack enhances atmosphere, lighting, terrain depth, and biome identity, while stripping away the invisible weight that most visual packs drag behind them.

## Compatibility
- Built for large worlds, tiny hardware, and everything between.
- Hypixel support integrated without overlap or instability.
- Multiple version branches planned, all carrying the same purpose, rebuilt per version.

## Development Status
Sheen is currently in **prototyping**. This is a phase of iteration, not completion. Stability exists only in the first tier, and everything beyond is being redesigned, tested, and optimized.

## Acknowledgments
Playtesters, builders, and early adopters shaped the pack's direction. Their feedback carved out what Sheen is becoming.
